column1: # A real vSphere 8 counter catalogue, as read from a production vCenter on
# Partial: the datastore and virtualDisk groups only. Those are the two the
# product got wrong — it asked for datastore.totalLatency.average and
# virtualDisk.totalLatency.average, neither of which exists, so every datastore
# and every virtual machine in the estate went unmeasured for storage latency
# The trap is worth seeing: disk.totalLatency.average DOES exist, at level 3.
# The name is plausible precisely because a sibling group has it. Plausible is
# how it survived being written down, reviewed and shipped without once being
# Groups not listed here are not checked. Add a group by pasting what a real
# vCenter returns — never by writing out what a counter is expected to be
# called, which is the mistake this file exists to stop repeating.
